message.content: {"mechanism_id":"relative-gain-threshold-selection","target_component":"selection","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-06","trace_path":"none","function":"F10","seed":0,"metric":"late_success_rate_vs_best_raw","observed_value":0.62},"causal_hypothesis":"On high-conditioning F10, tiny fitness deltas from near-flat directions are accepted as successes, inflating success counts without moving best_raw; requiring a relative gain filters these trivial acceptances.","algorithmic_change":"Replace accept-if trial_fit<=parent_fit with accept-if trial_fit <= parent_fit - tau*max(|parent_fit|,eps), where tau is a small fixed relative threshold; equal-or-better trials failing this test are rejected and not archived.","mathematical_rule":"accept iff trial_fit <= parent_fit - tau * max(|parent_fit|, eps); tau = 1e-3; eps = 1e-12; rejected trials do not enter archive and do not update M_F, M_CR.","expected_effect":"Late success rate drops toward early levels while best_raw decreases faster, since only conditioning-relevant improvements survive; memory updates reflect meaningful deltas.","failure_prediction":"If tau too large, progress stalls on rugged regions and population collapses prematurely; if too small, no filtering occurs and behavior matches baseline.","ablation_plan":"Compare tau in {0, 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2} on F10 across seeds; report late success rate, best_raw, and archive diversity to isolate threshold effect from memory dynamics.","nearest_known_methods":"Relative-improvement acceptance criteria in DE variants; epsilon-dominance selection; threshold acceptance in simulated annealing.","implementation_requirements":"Add tau and eps constants in selection loop; guard archive and Lehmer/weighted memory updates behind acceptance flag; log accepted-vs-rejected counts per generation."}
